fusions.name: Unhurried Fall
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wind-up, chops down through a cone 3 tiles ahead, which deals 34 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Splitting Wedge
fusions.desc: A chop usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. It deals 20 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Blades Along the Keel
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knows Where Shells Split
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
